Sms._comment: Provider=Log prints the code to the console. Set Provider=Msg91 with AuthKey and TemplateId to send real SMS; Production refuses to start on Log.

Payments._comment: Provider=Sandbox runs the built-in local gateway - no account, no money, refused in Production.
